headline: Brief Reports House Plan to Livestream ₱7.2-Trillion 2027 Budget Hearings
seoTitle: Brief: House Livestream Plan for ₱7.2T 2027 Budget
seoDescription: The ₱7.2-trillion 2027 budget proposal is independently confirmed; an FMB News brief additionally reports that House deliberations will be livestreamed.
deck: The newsroom brief describes a transparency plan for congressional review of the proposed 2027 national budget.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Reuters independently confirmed the proposed 2027 national budget at ₱7.2 trillion.

The FMB News evening brief additionally reports that House budget hearings will be livestreamed and cites an August 18 turnover and August 20 opening hearing. Those scheduling and livestream details remain source-attributed because the exact House or PNA release was not independently retrieved.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The budget total is independently supported; the livestream scope and exact dates remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Public access to budget deliberations can improve scrutiny of spending priorities and agency accountability.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the official House Appropriations calendar, livestream links and formal NEP turnover documents.
